files.text:
# Registry seed for `scen-check-fix-rewrites-implementation`.
#
# One Scenario whose then step names a function the greeter calls, an
# internal detail no user sees, where its description says what is
# observed: the greeting and the name printed. The fix rewrites the step
# in this entry as that output.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-21"
  description: "One scenario asserting an implementation detail"

scenarios:
  E2E-001:
    description: The greeter must print the configured greeting followed by the name it is given
    service: greeter
    path: tests/greeter/greet_test.go
    user_stories: []
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the greeting is configured as "Hello"
      when:
        - the Operator runs "greet Ada"
      then:
        - 'stdout matches ^Hello Ada$'
